## Core Technical Stack

- Frontend: React.js, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, Python, FastAPI, PHP, Laravel, RESTful APIs, Socket.IO (WebSockets)
- Databases & BaaS: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Cloud Functions)
- Mobile: React Native, Flutter
- AI & Machine Learning: scikit-learn, TF-IDF Vectorization, Cosine Similarity, Recommendation Microservices
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3), Vercel, Netlify, Render, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, Git, GitHub

## Flagship Project Case Studies

- [Primus Booking](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/primus-booking): Multi-portal SaaS appointment booking ecosystem (Customer, Business, Admin) built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase (Live: https://primusbooking.com/).
- [SkillBridge](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/skillbridge): AI-powered skill exchange platform built on the MERN stack with a Python FastAPI + scikit-learn recommendation microservice, Socket.IO real-time chat, scheduling, and 2FA (Live: https://www.skill-bridge.me/).
- [AdPulse](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/adpulse): Multi-tenant Google Ad Manager (GAM) revenue analytics dashboard with scheduled REST API ingestion, Firebase Auth custom claims, and Cloud Functions revenue-share engine (Live: https://adpulse.monetize360.eu/).
- [FIMIT AR Admin](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/fimit-ar-admin-panel): Admin dashboard for a 3D scanning and Augmented Reality web platform with real-time content management (Live: https://fim-it.com/).
- [Monetize 360 Global](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/monetize-360-global): SEO-optimized ad-tech marketing website built with React.js, Framer Motion, and EmailJS lead capture (Live: https://monetize360.global/).
- [TeraBit IT Company Website](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/terabit-it-website): Corporate website built in React.js with a modular, SEO-friendly component architecture (Live: https://terabit-site.vercel.app/).
- [Beam Balance](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/beam-balance): Secure document management system built with Next.js and AWS S3 storage.
- [Organization Task Tracker](https://junaiddev.skill-bridge.me/projects/organization-task-tracker): Team operations and task tracking platform built with Angular, Laravel, and MySQL.
